description: A subscript written on SEARCH or SEARCH ALL identifier-1 (SEARCH H (GI), where H is nested in G and GI subscripts G) - the enclosing tables' subscripts are a COBOL-2023 relaxation. ISO/IEC 1989:2023 14.9.37.3 SR2 bans the subscript only "at the level for which the SEARCH is applicable" and SR3 says "Identifier-1 may be contained within one or more other tables, for which the subscripting is still required"; the 2002 text (WG4/J4 post-ballot draft), the 2009 committee draft (CD 1.2) and the 2014 final committee draft (FCD 1.0, WG4, 2010-07-01, 14.9.34.2 ALL FORMATS rule 1) all say "Identifier-1 shall not be subscripted or reference modified", so every subscript on identifier-1 is refused below 2023. THE EDGE IS 2023 (kb/Work PB4609; owner decision of 2026-11-04 on PB4547, "Revert: 2023-only"): the 2014 FCD 1.0 was read and still carries the 2002 rule, so only the 2023 text of 14.9.37.3 SR2 and SR3 relaxes it; PB4577 had placed the edge at 2014 because the 2023 Annex E lists no SEARCH change. The published 2002 and 2014 texts and the 1985 text are not held, and 1985 is taken as no more permissive than 2002 (the 2002 Annex F list names no SEARCH relaxation). The bare spelling (SEARCH H, the enclosing occurrence supplied in the WHEN phrases, 14.9.37.4 GR1) is legal at every edition. Gated on RECOGNITION in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm (VisitSearchStatement and VisitSearchAllStatement, one body), so the edition is named even when the table does not resolve; a subscript at the searched level, which COBOL2075 refuses at every edition, also names 2023 below it, since below 2023 no subscript on identifier-1 is legal (VCR row 7.49).
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.37.3 SR2, SR3; the 2002 text, the 2009 CD 1.2 and the 2014 FCD 1.0 (14.9.34.2 ALL FORMATS rule 1) say "Identifier-1 shall not be subscripted or reference modified"
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.49 - SEARCH identifier-1 may carry the enclosing tables' subscripts from 2023 (kb/Work PB4609, PB4577)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMSIE.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 T-VALS PIC X(6) VALUE "123789".
01 T REDEFINES T-VALS.
   05 G OCCURS 2 TIMES INDEXED BY GI.
      10 H PIC 9 OCCURS 3 TIMES INDEXED BY HI.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN-PARA.
    SET GI TO 2
    SET HI TO 1
    SEARCH H (GI)
        AT END DISPLAY "NOT FOUND"
        WHEN H (GI, HI) > 7
            DISPLAY "FOUND " H (GI, HI)
    END-SEARCH
    STOP RUN.
